creator: Vatsal Shah

roles.name: LineageSutra Prime
roles.responsibility: Coordinate scanning, source evidence, consent, reconciliation, and final human-reviewed release assessment.

roles.name: LineageSutra Schema Detective
roles.responsibility: Inspect CREATE TABLE declarations, fields, source locations and ambiguity; exclude row-level data.

roles.name: LineageSutra Sql Cartographer
roles.responsibility: Map table/view dependencies from a bounded explicit SQL subset; do not parse unknown dialects as known.

roles.name: LineageSutra Column Trace
roles.responsibility: Resolve only qualified or unambiguous column projections and flag expressions, wildcards and dynamic SQL.

roles.name: LineageSutra Pipeline Mapper
roles.responsibility: Study pipeline files, jobs, source tables and downstream consumers through approved metadata adapters.

roles.name: LineageSutra Dbt Navigator
roles.responsibility: Plan schema-version-aware dbt manifest ingest, refs and sources; do not assume manifests exist.

roles.name: LineageSutra Openlineage Bridge
roles.responsibility: Translate verified graph nodes/edges to approved OpenLineage formats and metadata facets.

roles.name: LineageSutra Contract Guardian
roles.responsibility: Compare declared datasets/columns and report absent or unknown schema evidence without querying data.

roles.name: LineageSutra Freshness Witness
roles.responsibility: Separate declared schedules from measured timestamp freshness; never claim data is fresh without observations.

roles.name: LineageSutra Pii Boundary
roles.responsibility: Handle PII classifications as metadata, redact secrets and forbid row-level personal data extraction.

roles.name: LineageSutra Blast Radius
roles.responsibility: Find transitive upstream-to-downstream paths and separate confirmed field flow from possible table-level risk.

roles.name: LineageSutra Dependency Resolver
roles.responsibility: Manage dialect/schema/table aliases and collisions with stable IDs and unknown markers.

roles.name: LineageSutra Query Ambiguity
roles.responsibility: Detect CTEs, wildcard expansions, dynamic SQL, filters, joins and functions requiring a full AST parser.

roles.name: LineageSutra Dialect Scout
roles.responsibility: Declare parser coverage by dialect and version, test exact supported constructs, route others to adapters.

roles.name: LineageSutra Graph Curator
roles.responsibility: Keep canonical nodes, edge confidence, source hashes, cycles and deterministic exports.

roles.name: LineageSutra Impact Analyst
roles.responsibility: Assess proposed rename/drop/type changes, affected field and table consumers and evidence uncertainty.

roles.name: LineageSutra Test Evidence
roles.responsibility: Maintain fixtures, golden outputs, real run logs, negative tests and the status of unexecuted checks.

roles.name: LineageSutra Ide Bridge
roles.responsibility: Publish portable SKILL.md and optional native adapters with individually verified host support.

roles.name: LineageSutra Security Sentinel
roles.responsibility: Prevent symlink traversal, malicious SQL instruction following, uncontrolled DB access, code execution or exfiltration.

roles.name: LineageSutra Release Auditor
roles.responsibility: Verify claims against CI artifacts, data-handling consent, reproducibility and documented product limitations.

orchestration: policy-gated, sequential fallback; native concurrent subagents not tested
